title: garrytan/gbrain: an opinionated operating layer for personal agents
friendlyTitle: Gbrain provides a ready-made structure for personal AI agents
summary: Gbrain packages skills, recipes, evaluations and supporting tools for running a structured personal agent setup with OpenClaw or Hermes Agent. The active TypeScript project has more than 30,000 GitHub stars and frequent releases.
friendlySummary: Gbrain is a popular open project with skills, workflows and tests for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent setups.
whyItMatters: Agent builders can study a large, working collection of conventions for memory, workflows, skills and evaluation instead of designing every layer from scratch. Because it is deliberately opinionated and fast-moving, review its assumptions and installation steps before adopting it wholesale.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can borrow ideas for organising an agent system instead of starting from nothing. Read the setup carefully because the project changes often.
